source: CardInsider extraction pipeline (v3.1.1 baseline) + redemption_rules transform v1
_note: Six cards now value points at the issuer's own unconditional statement-credit rate instead of a lower catalogue rate: PhonePe HDFC Ultimo and Uno, HDFC Millennia, Paytm HDFC Select (all 0.30 -> 1.00), ICICI Mine (0.50 -> 1.00) and Kotak Mojo Platinum (0.20 -> 0.40). Only the two PhonePe cards move on screen (3.0% -> 10.0% and 1.0% -> 2.0%), and both were previously contradicting their own rule text, which is named '10% Reward Points' and '2% Reward Points'. Verified against HDFC's own T&C PDFs: '1 Reward Point is equivalent to Re.1 when redeemed as cashback against statement credit' / 'Re.0.3 of SmartBuy'. Cards whose only better channel is conditional — SmartBuy flights, airmiles transfer, travel portals, merchant vouchers — were deliberately left alone; valuing points there would overstate about 40 cards. Paytm HDFC Mobile was held back because its base_reward_rate of 0.5 would render 50%.
